proposal.summary: WinGate v9.4.1.5998 grants Authenticated Users full control over the installation directory, allowing a local authenticated user to replace WinGate.exe with a trojan and obtain SYSTEM privileges after a service restart or system reboot.
proposal.cwe_quote:
WinGate has insecure permissions for the installation directory, which allows local
users ability to gain privileges by replacing an executable file with a Trojan horse.

AC.quote: Logon as standard user replace WinGate.exe with a trojan executable, wait for restart or reboot the system, your code runs as SYSTEM.

PR.quote: Logon as standard user replace WinGate.exe with a trojan executable, wait for restart or reboot the system, your code runs as SYSTEM.

S.quote: your code runs as SYSTEM after a WinGate restart or system reboot.

C.quote: your code runs as SYSTEM after a WinGate restart or system reboot.

I.quote: your code runs as SYSTEM after a WinGate restart or system reboot.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify ACLs on the WinGate installation directory and remove write/Full Control for non-administrative users (e.g., remove 'Authenticated Users' full control). Request vendor provide a patched installer or guidance to set secure default permissions and publish a mitigation.
